evidence: X-ray reﬂectivity (XRR) data obtained from a short-period laminate containing 3 mol % yttria were consistent with a density increase from 5.78 ± 0.29 to 6.13 ± 0.31 g/cm³, similar to the density for commercially available bulk YSZ with the same yttria content. The root-mean-square roughness value decreased from 1.81 to 0.23 nm. The larger number of finite-thickness oscillations seen in the XRR pattern of the annealed sample results from the smoother film surface after annealing. Indexing of the electron diffraction rings suggests that these annealed alloy films are polycrystalline tetragonal, t-YSZ, which is the expected structure for bulk 3 mol % YSZ at temperatures less than 1000°C.
